meta.title: Terms of service
meta.description: FleetAi terms of service: account, plans and billing, data, liability and termination.

hero.title: Terms of
hero.subtitle: These terms govern the use of FleetAi. By creating an account, you accept them.

sections.title: Purpose
sections.body: These terms of service govern access to and use of the FleetAi platform, whatever plan you are on. By creating an account, you confirm that you have read and accepted them. If you use FleetAi on behalf of an organization, you warrant that you have the authority to bind it.

sections.title: The service
sections.body: FleetAi is an online fleet management and maintenance platform: boat and equipment tracking, maintenance planning, history, documents, cost estimates and AI-assisted features. The service evolves continuously: features may be added, changed or removed.

sections.title: Account and access
sections.body: Creating an account opens an organization that you own. You are responsible for how it is used:
bullets: You provide accurate information and keep it up to date.
You keep your password confidential and report any unauthorized access to us without delay.
You are accountable for the actions of the members you invite into your organization.
The service is reserved for adults.

sections.title: Plans, quotas and billing
sections.body: FleetAi comes in several plans, detailed with their prices on the Pricing page:
bullets: The Starter plan is free, with no credit card and no time limit; it is bounded by quotas (number of boats, number of members, storage space).
Paid plans are billed in advance, monthly or yearly, through our payment processor Stripe.
You can change plan or cancel at any time: cancellation takes effect at the end of the period already paid for, with no prorated refund.
Reaching a quota blocks adding new data, never access to the data already recorded.

sections.title: Your data and content
sections.body: You remain the owner of the data you import into FleetAi: boats, equipment, maintenance history, documents. You grant us only the rights needed to host it, process it and return it to you as part of the service. The processing of personal data is described in our privacy policy.

sections.title: AI features
sections.body: Cost estimates, maintenance suggestions and summaries generated by AI are provided for guidance only. They replace neither professional advice, nor a technical inspection, nor compliance with the regulations that apply to your fleet. Maintenance and navigation decisions remain your responsibility.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: When using FleetAi, you agree not to:
bullets: Use the service for unlawful purposes or in violation of a third party's rights.
Access or attempt to access data that does not belong to your organization, or circumvent quotas and access controls.
Decompile, reproduce or resell all or part of the platform.
Disrupt the service, in particular through bulk automated requests or systematic content extraction.

sections.title: Availability and support
sections.body: We do our best to keep the service available, without being able to guarantee uninterrupted access. Maintenance operations may be required; we schedule them outside business hours whenever possible. Support is provided by email at support@fleetai.app.

sections.title: Liability
sections.body: FleetAi is a management tool: it does not replace your obligations as an operator, owner or employer. We cannot be held liable for indirect damages such as loss of business or commercial harm. In any event, our liability is limited to the amounts you paid us over the twelve months preceding the triggering event.

sections.title: Suspension and termination
sections.body: You may request the closure of your account at any time by writing to the address at the bottom of this page. We may suspend or close an account in the event of a serious breach of these terms, after informing you except in an emergency. After closure, your data is deleted or anonymized under the conditions set out in the privacy policy.

sections.title: Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update these terms to reflect changes to the service or to the applicable regulations. The last update date appears at the top of this page, and substantial changes are notified to you. Continued use of the service after they take effect constitutes acceptance.

sections.title: Governing law and disputes
sections.body: These terms are governed by French law. In the event of a dispute, please contact us so that we can look for an amicable solution. Failing an agreement, the dispute will be brought before the competent French courts.

contact.title: A question about these terms?
contact.body: For any question about these terms or about your subscription, get in touch with us.
